sections.heading: Lanark, Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health: Providing Quality Care for Mental Health Patients

blocks.text: As a leading provider of mental health care, we are committed to delivering quality services that meet the unique needs of our clients. We recognize that each patient has their challenges and circumstances that require personalized attention. We offer a wide range of treatment options to address the different types of mental health disorders in our community. From counselling and residential treatment homes to psychiatry and family support, we aim to provide a comprehensive range of services that are catered towards your specific needs. Additionally, we believe in educating our clients on mental health to empower them to make the best decisions for their wellbeing.

sections.heading: Our Delivery of Services: Meeting You Where You Are

blocks.text: We understand that different individuals have different preferences when it comes to mental health treatment. While some may prefer face-to-face interaction, others may find it challenging to get to our office. Regardless of your preference, we will find a method that works best for you and meets you where you are in your mental health journey. Our team of professionals is available to deliver our services at your convenience, whether at your home or another location that suits you. We offer transportation services that ensure that you get to your appointments on time.

blocks.text: We recognize that addiction is a complex problem that requires a compassionate and comprehensive approach. Our community addictions services aim to provide support for individuals affected by substance abuse disorders. We offer a range of treatment options that include counselling, residential treatment homes, and medication-assisted therapies to facilitate a smooth transition to sober living. Our team of specialists works with clients to address the underlying physical and mental factors that contribute to addiction.

blocks.text: Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health is a trusted Non-Profit rehab center located in Delta, Ontario. The center focuses on providing high-quality treatments for individuals struggling with mental health, substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The facility has built up a reputation for its evidenced-based practices, which are founded upon years of research and proven results. They offer outpatient drug rehab for those who require ongoing support and access to professional assistance while maintaining their daily routines. To ensure that their clients receive comprehensive care, they provide a range of therapies such as individual, family and group counseling, in addition to a variety of holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art-based therapy.

centre.about_html:
Lanark, Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health: Providing Quality Care for Mental Health Patients

As a leading provider of mental health care, we are committed to delivering quality services that meet the unique needs of our clients. We recognize that each patient has their challenges and circumstances that require personalized attention. We offer a wide range of treatment options to address the different types of mental health disorders in our community. From counselling and residential treatment homes to psychiatry and family support, we aim to provide a comprehensive range of services that are catered towards your specific needs. Additionally, we believe in educating our clients on mental health to empower them to make the best decisions for their wellbeing.

Our Delivery of Services: Meeting You Where You Are

We understand that different individuals have different preferences when it comes to mental health treatment. While some may prefer face-to-face interaction, others may find it challenging to get to our office. Regardless of your preference, we will find a method that works best for you and meets you where you are in your mental health journey. Our team of professionals is available to deliver our services at your convenience, whether at your home or another location that suits you. We offer transportation services that ensure that you get to your appointments on time.

Our Community Addictions Services

We recognize that addiction is a complex problem that requires a compassionate and comprehensive approach. Our community addictions services aim to provide support for individuals affected by substance abuse disorders. We offer a range of treatment options that include counselling, residential treatment homes, and medication-assisted therapies to facilitate a smooth transition to sober living. Our team of specialists works with clients to address the underlying physical and mental factors that contribute to addiction.

Our Hoarding Intervention Program

Hoarding can be a challenging problem that affects many people. It can lead to hazardous living conditions that pose a risk to the individual’s health and safety. We offer a hoarding intervention program that aims to support individuals who struggle with hoarding. Our trained professionals offer support, advice, and practical solutions to help reduce hoarding, and facilitate a safe living environment.




Lanark- Center Overview

Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health is a trusted Non-Profit rehab center located in Delta, Ontario. The center focuses on providing high-quality treatments for individuals struggling with mental health, substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The facility has built up a reputation for its evidenced-based practices, which are founded upon years of research and proven results. They offer outpatient drug rehab for those who require ongoing support and access to professional assistance while maintaining their daily routines. To ensure that their clients receive comprehensive care, they provide a range of therapies such as individual, family and group counseling, in addition to a variety of holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art-based therapy.

At Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health, they strive to create a relaxing and secure environment that aids clients in their recovery journey. Their facility is well equipped with state-of-the-art amenities that make life comfortable for clients throughout their rehabilitation process. They offer a list of amenities tailored to help clients achieve long-term recovery. These include outpatient drug rehab, art and nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and a host of personalized treatment plans. The facility’s comprehensive approach assists clients in achieving their goals while assisting them in developing essential life skills. At Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health, they believe that every individual deserves customized care and support to achieve long-lasting physical, emotional, and psychological well-being.

Frequently Asked Questions About Lanark

What types of mental health disorders do you treat?

We offer treatment for a wide range of mental health disorders, including depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and more.

What types of residential treatment homes do you offer?

We offer residential treatment homes for individuals with substance abuse disorders, eating disorders, and mental health disorders.

What is your counselling approach?

We use evidence-based psychological approaches such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), and eye-movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR).

What is your housing program?

Our housing program offers safe and affordable housing for individuals with mental health disorders who require additional support.

What is your youth program?

Our youth program offers support for young people between the ages of 12-24 who are experiencing mental health disorders.

Lanark, Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health: Providing Quality Care for Mental Health Patients

As a leading provider of mental health care, we are committed to delivering quality services that meet the unique needs of our clients. We recognize that each patient has their challenges and circumstances that require personalized attention. We offer a wide range of treatment options to address the different types of mental health disorders in our community. From counselling and residential treatment homes to psychiatry and family support, we aim to provide a comprehensive range of services that are catered towards your specific needs. Additionally, we believe in educating our clients on mental health to empower them to make the best decisions for their wellbeing.

Our Delivery of Services: Meeting You Where You Are

We understand that different individuals have different preferences when it comes to mental health treatment. While some may prefer face-to-face interaction, others may find it challenging to get to our office. Regardless of your preference, we will find a method that works best for you and meets you where you are in your mental health journey. Our team of professionals is available to deliver our services at your convenience, whether at your home or another location that suits you. We offer transportation services that ensure that you get to your appointments on time.

Our Community Addictions Services

We recognize that addiction is a complex problem that requires a compassionate and comprehensive approach. Our community addictions services aim to provide support for individuals affected by substance abuse disorders. We offer a range of treatment options that include counselling, residential treatment homes, and medication-assisted therapies to facilitate a smooth transition to sober living. Our team of specialists works with clients to address the underlying physical and mental factors that contribute to addiction.

Our Hoarding Intervention Program

Hoarding can be a challenging problem that affects many people. It can lead to hazardous living conditions that pose a risk to the individual’s health and safety. We offer a hoarding intervention program that aims to support individuals who struggle with hoarding. Our trained professionals offer support, advice, and practical solutions to help reduce hoarding, and facilitate a safe living environment.




Lanark- Center Overview

Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health is a trusted Non-Profit rehab center located in Delta, Ontario. The center focuses on providing high-quality treatments for individuals struggling with mental health, substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The facility has built up a reputation for its evidenced-based practices, which are founded upon years of research and proven results. They offer outpatient drug rehab for those who require ongoing support and access to professional assistance while maintaining their daily routines. To ensure that their clients receive comprehensive care, they provide a range of therapies such as individual, family and group counseling, in addition to a variety of holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art-based therapy.

At Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health, they strive to create a relaxing and secure environment that aids clients in their recovery journey. Their facility is well equipped with state-of-the-art amenities that make life comfortable for clients throughout their rehabilitation process. They offer a list of amenities tailored to help clients achieve long-term recovery. These include outpatient drug rehab, art and nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and a host of personalized treatment plans. The facility’s comprehensive approach assists clients in achieving their goals while assisting them in developing essential life skills. At Lanark – Leeds and Grenville Addictions and Mental Health, they believe that every individual deserves customized care and support to achieve long-lasting physical, emotional, and psychological well-being.
